name: Main Ridge
intro: Main Ridge is an elevated, unhurried stretch of Peninsula wine country: cellar doors, farm gates and bushland roads rather than a dense village centre. Ten Minutes by Tractor and Red Hill Estate both list Main Ridge addresses. Book a tasting or lunch before heading up, then leave time for the quieter side roads. Nearby Red Hill and Red Hill South widen the food-and-wine circuit, but each is a separate locality.
factualLede: Main Ridge is a rural locality on the Mornington Peninsula's elevated wine-country plateau, with cellar doors and farm-gate stops along its winding roads.

tldr: Main Ridge is a rural wine-country locality with cellar doors and farm-gate stops, rather than a compact shopping village.
Best for: wine tourists who want something unhurried; walkers with an eye for wildlife; anyone overdoing Sorrento and needing to recalibrate.
Signature experience: Greens Bush at dusk when the eastern grey kangaroos emerge.
Half-day is sufficient; pair with Red Hill for a full day.
bestFor: the most focused cellar door day
notFor: anyone trying to cram five stops into one day
worstTime: rainy winter weekdays when venues shut early
signature: A high, quiet part of the Peninsula wine country, where the pinot is best and the road narrows.
skip: Rushing - Main Ridge rewards slow, intentional visits.
bestDay: Two cellar doors maximum, a long lunch at Ten Minutes by Tractor or similar, no agenda for the afternoon.
insiderNote: Book lunch first and build the wine stops around it - that is how locals avoid wasting the day in the car.
